description:
Test a regular expression against text. Returns all matches and capture groups.

Returns: JSON { matches: string[], count } of matches for the pattern.
Example input: {"pattern":"\\d+","flags":"g","text":"order 42 shipped on day 7"}
On error, includes hint: `pattern` is a JS RegExp source (double-escape backslashes in JSON). `flags` uses standard flags like g, i, m, s.
name: regex_test
title: Test regex
